rubric_items.reason: Every story traces at least one REQ. Together they trace REQ-1 to REQ-15, which covers all 12 known and all 3 assumed REQs in the intent.
S-2, S-3 and S-4 each deliver one outcome. S-1 puts the column, the ranking, the time zone and the format in one story. That is acceptable but on the large side.
The frontmatter criteria all use Given/When/Then. The body versions of S-2 to S-4 are short statements without Given/When/Then. S-3 AC2 and AC3 depend on an unstated 'before the change' baseline.
Most values come from the intent: 20 per page, '-', Asia/Kolkata, the start time. S-1 AC3 adds UTC, which the intent never mentions.
Readable, and the glossary statuses are used consistently. The body criteria are worded differently from the frontmatter criteria, and S-3 AC1 says 'more patients than fit on one page' instead of 20.

findings.text: S-1 AC3 uses UTC to set up the time-zone case. UTC does not appear in the intent, so this is a weakly sourced value. The intent only says the date is in Asia/Kolkata.

cites.quote: starts at a time whose calendar date differs between UTC and Asia/Kolkata
The `Last visit` date is expressed in the hospital time zone, `Asia/Kolkata`.

findings.suggested_fix: Describe the case in terms the intent uses, for example a start time near midnight Asia/Kolkata. Or cite where UTC storage is documented.

findings.text: The body criteria for S-2, S-3 and S-4 are short statements, not Given/When/Then, and do not match the frontmatter. Example: S-2 AC3 in the body drops its Given condition.

cites.quote: AC3: A Scheduled appointment is never shown; the Completed one is shown instead.
Given a patient with a `Scheduled` appointment and an earlier Completed appointment

findings.suggested_fix: Make the body criteria repeat the frontmatter Given/When/Then text.

findings.text: S-3 AC2 and AC3 compare against 'before the change' without saying how that baseline is captured. That makes them regression checks with no reference result defined.

cites.quote: then the same patients are returned as before the change
then patients appear in the same sort order as before the change

findings.suggested_fix: Specify a fixed dataset and search term, and compare against the result captured on the pre-change build.

findings.text: The Given in S-3 AC1 is circular: 'more patients than fit on one page' assumes the page size the criterion is meant to check. Use the explicit value from REQ-8.

cites.quote: Given more patients than fit on one page, when staff open the patient list

findings.suggested_fix: Given more than 20 patients exist, when staff open the patient list, then the first page shows 20.

cites.quote: A past appointment the patient attended, closed by staff once its start time has passed.
An appointment that is booked and still open.

in the MVP every
user acts as `staff`
Blood group, allergies, chronic conditions, current medications and notes of one patient.
